facts.fact: 苏齐开着一辆破旧厢式货车穿过赫尔利村的砖石民居
facts.anchor: Suzie drove her battered van through the jumble

facts.fact: 贝克斯惊讶地问这里竟然住着一位足球明星
facts.anchor: ‘A footballer lives here?’ Becks asked, amazed.

facts.fact: 苏齐说明这处地址是塔妮卡提供的
facts.anchor: It’s the address Tanika gave us

facts.fact: 苏齐嫌这栋宅子穿堂风大、烟囱太多
facts.anchor: Look at those windows! Imagine the draughts!

facts.fact: 贝克斯说加里常年出入夜店、总上花边新闻
facts.anchor: he’d be pictured falling out of nightclubs

facts.fact: 苏齐从腰包里掏出文职调查员证件亮明身份
facts.anchor: Suzie pulled her civilian adviser warrant card

facts.fact: 屋里的女人自称贝思尼·怀斯
贝思尼说管家哈里·阿斯奎特正在写加里的自传
facts.anchor: That guy’s Harry Asquith. He’s been writing Gary’s autobiography.

facts.fact: 贝思尼在更衣室里听到一声巨响
facts.anchor: I was in my dressing room when I heard this bang.

facts.fact: 贝思尼打给哈里·阿斯奎特但电话直接转到语音信箱
facts.anchor: He didn’t answer his phone, it went straight to voicemail.

facts.fact: 警员二十分钟后赶到树林并发现了加里
facts.anchor: a police constable arrived about twenty minutes later

facts.fact: 贝思尼说他们夫妇在镇上并不认识什么人
facts.anchor: We don’t really know anyone in town.

facts.fact: 贝思尼要求把杀人凶手上法庭重判
facts.anchor: I want them in prison – the key thrown away.

facts.fact: 贝思尼承认加里前一天曾联系过一名记者
facts.anchor: your husband told her he had something

facts.fact: 贝思尼接起母亲电话后当场痛哭
facts.anchor: they heard Bethany greet her mum and then burst into tears
